title: 云依助手 0.13.17 · 依依快捷入口与位置修复
releaseNotes: Centered the desktop character and drag frame across display scales. Removed automatic edge-tucking and its wait setting. Replaced the desktop interaction menu with Toolbox, My Finance and Personal Learning shortcuts, with editable local HTTP(S) website settings and default-browser opening. Unconfigured shortcuts lead to settings without visiting a placeholder site. Preserved reminder placards, completion, snooze and manual hiding; protected reminder positioning during dragging and display-scale changes. Full offline WebView2 and VC++ prerequisites remain included for Windows 10/11 x64 USB distribution.
